lambda.name: bd-gold-trigger

lambda_functions.lambda: Starts bd-gold-layer-runner (PROD EC2 i-01003b035d2988dfb) via SSM to execute the nightly gold chain. Starts bd-allocations EC2 and runs opal-bd-allocation-download SSM document to download allocation files from Black Diamond at 22:00 UTC Mon-Fri.

Starts bd-allocations EC2 and runs opal-bd-unrealized-download SSM document at 21:38 UTC Mon-Fri. Daily snapshot — full replacement each day.

Spawns ephemeral t3.xlarge EC2 (historical-prices-fetcher) at 14:00 UTC daily (9 AM ET) to run yfinance fetch and write silver/historical_prices.parquet. EC2 auto-terminates on completion (ManagedBy=lambda-scheduler tag).

triggers.trigger: cron(0 4 * * ? *) — daily 04:00 UTC (midnight ET EDT, 11 PM ET EST), all days including weekends/holidays. Runs silver-prep (S_00 build_canonical_prices_v2.py) before gold chain freshness gate. Primary production gold trigger since 2026-04-15.
cron(38 21 ? * MON-FRI *) — 21:38 UTC Mon-Fri (5:38 PM ET). Daily unrealized gains snapshot download from Black Diamond.
cron(45 21 ? * MON-FRI *) — 21:45 UTC Mon-Fri. Incremental realized capital gains download.
cron(53 21 ? * MON-FRI *) — 21:53 UTC Mon-Fri. Daily transaction file download.
cron(0 22 ? * MON-FRI *) — 22:00 UTC Mon-Fri. Daily allocation file download. Also triggers bd-price-runner (bd_price_update.py) at end of SSM sequence.
cron(10 22 ? * MON-FRI *) — 22:10 UTC Mon-Fri. AssetDimTXNs daily download + silver conversion (BDPL_ASTDIM.W6).
cron(15 22 ? * MON-FRI *) — 22:15 UTC Mon-Fri. Fees_OpalCapital_Daily download + silver conversion.
cron(30 22 ? * MON-FRI *) — 22:30 UTC Mon-Fri. Checks for missing allocation file; SNS alert if absent.
cron(0 23 ? * MON-SAT *) — 23:00 UTC Mon-Sat. Safety net in case S3 price trigger was dropped (e.g. EC2 busy with manual run). Pending-marker mechanism handles race with in-progress runs.
cron(0 8 1 * ? *) — 08:00 UTC on 1st of each month. Full gold rebuild. DISABLED — monthly full run not currently active.
cron(0 14 * * ? *) — 14:00 UTC daily (9 AM ET), all days. Spawns ephemeral EC2 for yfinance historical price fetch.

Fires on s3:ObjectCreated:* for dated silver price parquets (e.g. 2026-04-14.parquet). Does NOT match canonical_prices.parquet (starts with 'c'). Primary event-driven gold chain trigger.
